templates.title: 30 s product ad
templates.description: Hook, hero shots and a clear call to action for one product.

defaults.prompt_scaffold: A 30-second product ad for [product], aimed at [audience]. Open on a three-second hook: [problem the product solves] shown in a real everyday moment. Reveal the product in a slow hero shot on [surface or setting] with soft studio light and crisp reflections. Show two quick close-ups of [key feature 1] and [key feature 2] in use. End on the product centred in frame with the line "[tagline]".

templates.title: 60 s brand story
templates.description: Where the brand came from, who it is for and why it matters, in one minute.

defaults.prompt_scaffold: A 60-second brand story for [brand], told by [founder or narrator]. Begin with the moment the idea started: [origin moment] in [place]. Follow the people who make it, hands at work on [craft or process], in warm natural light. Show [customer] using it in their own life and what changes for them. Close on the brand mark over [closing image] with the line "[brand promise]".

templates.title: 2 min documentary
templates.description: A short observational documentary with narration and a clear arc.

defaults.prompt_scaffold: A two-minute documentary about [subject] in [location]. Establish the place at [time of day] with wide, patient shots. Introduce [main person] and what they do every day. Build toward the central tension: [challenge or change they face]. Include one quiet moment of [detail that reveals character]. End with where things stand now and a lingering wide shot of [closing image]. Calm, factual narration.

templates.title: Music-video montage (1 min)
templates.description: A rhythm-led montage of moods and places, no dialogue.

defaults.prompt_scaffold: A one-minute music-video montage for a [genre] track about [theme]. Cut between [performer or character] in [main location] and short evocative moments: [image 1], [image 2], [image 3]. Colour palette of [colours], camera movement that follows the beat, energy rising toward a final chorus shot of [climax image].

templates.title: Short film (5 min)
templates.description: Opens a full studio project: script, cast, storyboard and render, scene by scene.

defaults.prompt_scaffold: A five-minute short film. [Main character], who wants [goal], is stopped by [obstacle] in [setting]. Over one [day or night] they must [choice], and the ending turns on [twist or revelation]. Tone: [tone].

templates.title: Social vertical teaser (15 s)
templates.description: A punchy 9:16 teaser for Reels, Shorts and TikTok.

defaults.prompt_scaffold: A 15-second vertical teaser for [thing being announced]. First second: a bold close-up of [striking image] to stop the scroll. Three fast beats showing [beat 1], [beat 2] and [beat 3]. End on [final frame] with the text "[date or call to action]".
